Rhea Kapoor (Candidate): Hi team — quick situation. My OPT STEM EAD expires 2026-06-20. I was selected in the H-1B cap and have an approved petition (I-797) but Im currently outside the US for family reasons until 2026-06-25. My offer start is 2026-07-01. Can I re-enter and start on 7/1, and can benefits/payroll be set up if Im doing I-9 on my first day? Also background check got flagged for a name spelling difference on the passport vs university docs.

Jae Park (People Ops): Hey Rhea :wave: short answers up front: 1) If you have an approved H-1B I-797 you can present that for visa stamping and re-entry. 2) I-9 must be completed when youre physically in the US; we can delay the I-9 to your first business day back. 3) Benefits/payroll: we can tentatively set enrollment but final effective date depends on I-9 completion. 4) For the background name mismatch we usually need supporting docs (marriage certificate or official name-change) or a notarized affidavit. Please upload scanned docs to the secure portal.

Priya Rao (Legal): A couple of legal points: - Cap-gap usually applies to F-1 status extension when an H-1B change of status is pending; since your H-1B is approved and youre outside the US, youll need consular stamping to enter under H-1. - Timing: consulate appointment availability can be a risk; plan for potential delays. - If your EAD expired while outside and you re-enter on H-1: once admitted youre H-1 authorized and employment can commence. - On the name mismatch: consulates and employers often ask for a chain of documents; provide the background-check team with the explanation doc and any legal name-change evidence.

Carlos Mendes (Hiring Manager): Team we can be flexible. Rhea, welcome aboard! We can schedule async onboarding work for week 1 that doesn't require payroll access. Please list any systems you need before day 1 and well see what can be provisioned with limited access.

Rhea Kapoor (Candidate): Thanks. I need GitHub, Jira view access, and product docs. Not requesting VPN or prod keys until I-9 done. Also my passport has a slightly different middle name spelling than my diploma. I'll upload an affidavit and the diploma scan.

BackgroundCheckBot: Background check flagged: name_variation. Next steps: submit affidavit + government ID + university transcript. Candidate portal ID: BG-2026-90012.

Jae Park (People Ops): Action items Ill do now: 1) Create payroll/benefits tentative enrollment ticket and request exception to hold effective date 2026-07-01 pending I-9. 2) Draft note to Security to grant read-only GitHub and Jira access until I-9 verification. 3) Add reminder to complete I-9 on first business day back and provide list of accepted docs.

PayrollBot: Note logged: PR-EXC-2026-778. Payroll will withhold pay activation until HR confirms completed I-9. If I-9 completed within first pay period, payroll can retro-pay for missed days subject to approvals.

BenefitsBot: Benefits hold ticket BNFT-2026-5512 opened. Tentative effective date 2026-07-01 pending confirmation of I-9. Please attach payroll exception approval to this ticket.

Priya Rao (Legal): One more: consulate may request employer letter. I can prepare a short employment verification letter for stamping appointment. Also recommend scheduling the consulate appointment ASAP and keeping our counsel on call if any RFEs arise.

Rhea Kapoor (Candidate): Perfect — please cc me on the payroll/benefits note and the employer letter. I'll book a consulate slot for 2026-06-26 and upload documents today. Appreciate the flexibility! :smile:
